arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ أَحَداً لاَ يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً إلاّ حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُهُ شُكْرَاً، وَلا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغاً مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَإن اجْتَهَدَ إلاَّ كَانَ مُقَصِّراً دُونَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ،
transliteration: allahumma innahu la yablughu min shukrika ghayatan illaḥ ḥaṣala ʿalayhi min iḥsanika mā yulzimuhu shukran walā yablughu mablaghan min ta'atika wa in ijtaḥada 'illa kāna muqaṣṣiran dūna istiḥqāqika bifadlik
english_text: O God, no one reaches a limit in thanking Thee without acquiring that of Thy beneficence which enjoins upon him thanksgiving, nor does anyone reach a degree in obeying Thee, even if he strives, without falling short of what Thou deservest because of Thy bounty.

arabic_text: فَأَشْكَرُ عِبَادِكَ عَاجِزٌ عَنْ شُكْرِكَ وَأَعْبَدُهُمْ مُقَصِّرٌ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ،
transliteration: fa-ashkaru ʿibādika ʿājizun ʿan shukrika wa'aʿbaduhum muqaṣṣirun ʿan ṭaaʿatika
english_text: The most thankful of Thy servants has not the capacity to thank Thee, and the most worshipful of them falls short of obeying Thee.

arabic_text: لا يَجبُ لأِحَد أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَهُ بِاسْتِحْقَاقِهِ، وَلا أَنْ تَرْضَى عَنْهُ بِاسْتِيجَابِهِ،
transliteration: lā yajubu li'aḥad an taghfira lahū bi-istiḥqāqihi walā an tarḍā ʿanhu bi-istījābih
english_text: To none of them is due Thy forgiveness through what he himself deserves or Thy good pleasure for his own merit.

arabic_text: فَمَنْ غَفَرْتَ لَهُ فَبِطَولِكَ، وَمَنْ رَضِيْتَ عَنْهُ فَبِفَضْلِكَ
transliteration: faman ghafartalahu fabitawlika wa man raḍīta ʿanhu fabi faḍlika
english_text: When Thou forgivest someone, it is through Thy graciousness, and when Thou art pleased with someone, it is through Thy bounty.

arabic_text: تَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا شُكِرْتَهُ وَتُثِيبُ عَلَى قَلِيلِ مَا تُطَاعُ فِيهِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّ شُكْـرَ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِيْ أَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيْهِ ثَوَابَهُمْ وَأَعْظَمْتَ عَنْهُ جَزَاءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مَلَكُوا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الامْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُونَكَ
transliteration: tashkuru yasira ma shukirtahu wa tuthibu 'ala qaleelin ma tuta'afihu ḥattá ka'anna shukra ʿibādika alladhī awjabta ʿalayhi thawābahum wa'aẓamt(a) ʿanhu jazāʾahum amrun malakū istiṭāʿata al-imtināʿi minhu dūnaka
english_text: Thou showest gratitude for the paltry for which gratitude is shown to Thee and Thou rewardest the small act in which Thou art obeyed, so that it seems as if Thy servants' thanksgiving for which Thou hast made incumbent their reward and made great their repayment is an affair from which they could have held back without Thee,

arabic_text: فَكَافَيْتَهُمْ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُهُ بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ،
transliteration: fakaafaytahum aw lam yakun sababuhu biyadika fajaazaytahum
english_text: and hence Thou wilt recompense them, and whose cause is not in Thy hand, and hence Thou wilt repay them.

arabic_text: بَـلْ مَلَكْتَ يَا إلهِي أَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْلِكُوا عِبَادَتَكَ، وَأَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضُوا فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
transliteration: bal malakta yā ilāhī amrahum qabla an yamlikū ibādataka wa'aʿdadta thawābahum qabla an yufīḍū fī ṭāʿatika
english_text: Nay, my God, Thou hadst power over their affair before they had power to worship Thee, and Thou hadst prepared their reward before they began to obey Thee;

arabic_text: وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ سُنَّتَكَ الأِفْضَالُ، وَعَادَتَكَ الإحْسَانُ، وَسَبِيلَكَ الْعَفْوُ،
transliteration: wa dhalika anna sunnataka al-afḍal wa ʿadatka al-iḥsānu, wa sabīlaka al-ʿafwu
english_text: and that because Thy wont is bestowal of bounty, Thy custom beneficence, Thy way pardon.

arabic_text: فَكُلُّ الْبَرِيِّةِ مًعْتَرِفَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ، وَشَاهِدَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلَى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ،
transliteration: fakullu al-bariyyati muʿtarifatun bi-annaka ghayru ẓalim li-man ʿaqabta wa shāhidatun bi-annaka mutafadhdhilun ʿalā man ʿāfayta
english_text: So all creatures confess that Thou wrongest not him whom Thou punishest and bear witness that Thou bestowest bounty upon him whom Thou pardonest.

arabic_text: وَكُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّقْصِيْرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ،
transliteration: wa kullun muqirrun ʿalā nafsihi bi-t-taqṣīri ʿammā mustawjabt
english_text: Each admits that he has fallen short of what Thou meritest.

arabic_text: فَلَوْلا أَنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَخْتَدِعُهُمْ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ ما عَصاكَ عاصٍ وَلَوْلا أَنَّهُ صَوَّرَ لَهُمُ البَاطِلَ فِي مِثَالِ الْحَقِّ مَا ضَلَّ عَنْ طَرِيْقِكَ ضَالٌّ.
transliteration: fala-wlā anna ash-shaytān-a yakh-taḍiʿuhum ʿan ṭāʿatika mā ʿaṣāka walawla annahu sawwara lahumul-batila fi mithali al-haqqi maḍalla ʿan ṭarīqika ḍāllun
english_text: Had Satan not misled them from Thy obedience, no disobeyer would have disobeyed Thee, and had he not shown falsehood to them in the likeness of truth no strayer would have gone astray from Thy path.

arabic_text: فَسُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَبْيَنَ كَرَمَكَ فِي مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ أَوْ عَصَاكَ،
transliteration: fasubḥānaka mā ʾabyana karamaka fī muʿāmalati man ʾaṭāʿaka aw ʿaṣāka
english_text: So glory be to Thee! How manifest is Thy generosity in dealing with him who obeys or disobeys Thee!

arabic_text: تَشْكُرُ للْمُطِيْعِ مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لَهُ، وَتُمْلِي لِلْعَاصِي فِيْمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُ فِيْهِ،
transliteration: taškurul-limuṭīʿi mā ʾanta tawallaytahu lah wa tumli li-l-ʿāṣī fīmā tamliku muʿājalatahu fīhi
english_text: Thou showest gratitude to the obedient for that which Thou undertakest for him, and Thou grantest a respite to the disobedient in that within which Thou art able to hurry him.

arabic_text: أَعْطَيْتَ كُلاًّ مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَهُ، وَتَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُهُ عَنْهُ
transliteration: ʾaʿṭayta kullan minhuma mā lam yajib lah wa tafaḍḍaltu ʿalā kullin minhumā bimā yaqsuru ʿamaluhu ʿanhu
english_text: Thou givest to each of them that which is not his due, and Thou bestowest bounty upon each in that wherein his works fall short.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ كَافَأْتَ الْمُطِيعَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لاَوْشَكَ أَنْ يَفْقِدَ ثَوَابَكَ، وَأَنْ تَزُولَ عَنْهُ نِعْمَتُكَ وَلكِنَّكَ بِكَرَمِكَ جَازَيْتَهُ
transliteration: wa law kāfā'ta al-muṭīʿa ʿalā mā ʾanta tawallaytahu lāw shakka ʾan yafqiḍa thawābak wa an tazūla ʿanhu niʿmatuka wa lakinnaka bikaramika jazaytahu
english_text: Wert Thou to counterbalance for the obedient servant that which Thou Thyself hadst undertaken, he would be on the point of losing Thy reward and seeing the end of Thy favour, but through Thy generosity Thou hast repaid him

arabic_text: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ الفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ، وَعَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغايَةِ الْمَدِيدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ،
transliteration: ʿalā al-muddati al-qaṣīrah al-fāniyah bil-muddati aṭ-ṭawīlah al-khālidah wa ʿalā al-ghāyati al-qarībah al-zāʾilah bil-ghāyati al-madīdah al-bāqiyah
english_text: for a short, perishing term with a long, everlasting term, and for a near, vanishing limit with an extended, abiding limit.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيمَا أَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الَّذِي يَقْوَى بِهِ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ، وَلَـمْ تَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى الْمُنَاقَشَاتِ فِي الآلاتِ الَّتِي تَسَبَّبَ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا إلَى مَغْفِـرَتِكَ،
transliteration: thumma lam tasumhu al-qisasa fee ma akala min rizqik alladhī yaqwá bihi ʿalá ṭāʿatika walam tahmilhu ʿalal-munāqašātifil-ālāt al-latī tasabbaba bi istiʿmālihā ilā maghfiratika
english_text: Then Thou dost not visit him with a settling of accounts for Thy provision through which he gained strength to obey Thee, nor dost Thou force him to make reckonings for the organs he employed to find the means to Thy forgiveness.

arabic_text: وَلَـوْ فَعَلْتَ ذلِكَ بِهِ لَذَهَبَ بِجَمِيْعِ مَا كَدَحَ لَهُ وَجُمْلَةِ مَا سَعَى فِيهِ، جَزَاءً لِلصُّغْرى مِنْ أَيادِيْكَ وَمِنَنِكَ،
transliteration: walaw faʿalta dhalika bihi laḏahaba bijamīʿi mā kadaha lah wa-jumlati mā saʿā fīhi jazā'an li-ṣ-ṣughrā min ayādīka wa minannika
english_text: Wert Thou to do that to him, it would take away everything for which he had laboured and all wherein he had exerted himself as repayment for the smallest of Thy benefits and kindnesses,

arabic_text: وَلَبَقِيَ رَهيناً بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
transliteration: walabaqiya raheenan bayna yadayka bisa'iri ni'mika
english_text: and he would remain hostage before Thee for Thy other favours.

arabic_text: فَمَتَى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئاً مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ ، لا ، مَتَى؟.
transliteration: famataa kana yastahiqq shay'an min thawabika, la, mataa?
english_text: So how can he deserve something of Thy reward? Indeed, how?

arabic_text: هَذَا يا إلهِي حَالُ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَسَبِيلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ،
transliteration: hādhā yā ilāhī ḥālu man aṭāʿaka wa sabīlu man taʿabbada laka
english_text: This, my God, is the state of him who obeys Thee and the path of him who worships Thee.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا الْعَاصِيْ أَمْرَكَ وَالْمُوَاقِـعُ نَهْيَكَ فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَيْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهِ فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ حَالَ الاِنَابَـةِ إلَى طَـاعَتِـكَ، وَلَقَـدْ كَـانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِي أَوَّلِ مَـا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ
transliteration: fa'ammā al-ʿāṣiyu amraka wal-muwāqiʿu nahyaka falamm tuʿājilhu bināqimati-ka li-ky yastabdila bi-ḥāli-hi fī maʿṣiyatika ḥāla al-inābati ilā ṭāʿatika wa-laqad kāna yastahiqq fī awwali mā hamma bi-ʿiṣyānik
english_text: But as for him who disobeys Thy command and goes against Thy prohibition, Thou dost not hurry him to Thy vengeance, so that he may seek to replace his state in disobeying Thee with the state of turning back to obey Thee, though he deserved from the time he set out to disobey Thee

arabic_text: كُلَّ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ،
transliteration: kullamaa aʿdadta li-jameeʿi khalqika min ʿuqubatika
english_text: every punishment which Thou hast prepared for all Thy creatures.

arabic_text: فَجَمِيعُ مَا أَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ مِنْ الْعَذَابِ، وَأَبْطَأتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَالْعِقَابِ تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ، وَرِضىً بِدُونِ وَاجِبِكَ،
transliteration: fajamiʿu mā ʾakhkhartahū min al-ʿadhāb wa 'abta'ta bihi 'alayhi min satawaat al-naqimah wal-'iqaab tarakun min haqqika wa riḍān bidūni wājibika
english_text: Through each chastisement which Thou hast kept back from him and each penalty of Thy vengeance and Thy punishment which Thou hast delayed from him, Thou hast refrained from Thy right and shown good pleasure in place of what Thou hast made obligatory.

arabic_text: فَمَنْ أكْرَمُ يَا إلهِي مِنْكَ
transliteration: faman akramu ya ilahi minka
english_text: So who is more generous, my God, than Thou?

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَشْقَى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْـكَ، لا ، مَنْ؟
transliteration: wa-man ashqā mimman halaka ʿalayka, lā, man?
english_text: And who is more wretched than he who perishes in spite of Thee? Indeed, who?

arabic_text: فَتَبَارَكْتَ أَنْ تُوصَفَ إلاّ بِالإحْسَانِ، وَكَـرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إلاّ الْعَدْلُ،
transliteration: fatabarakt(a) 'an tuwṣaf(a) 'ill(a) bil-'iḥsān(i) wa karumta an yukhafa minka illa al-'adl
english_text: Thou art too blessed to be described by any but beneficence and too generous for any but justice to be feared from Thee!

arabic_text: لا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ، وَلاَ يُخَافُ إغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ.
transliteration: lā yukhshā jawruka ʿalā man ʿasāka walā yukhāfu ʾiġfāluka thawāba man ʾarḍāka
english_text: There is no dread that Thou wilt be unjust toward him who disobeys Thee, nor any fear of Thy neglecting to reward him who satisfies Thee.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمَلِي، وَزِدْنِي مِنْ هُدَاكَ مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِي عَمَلِي،
transliteration: fasalli ʿala muhammadin wa ālihi wa hab li amalī wa zidni min hudak ma aṣilu bihī ilā al-tawfīq fī ʿamalī
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, give me my hope, and increase me in that of Thy guidance through which I may be successful in my works!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ مَنَّانٌ كَرِيمٌ.
transliteration: 'innaka mannānun karīmun
english_text: Surely Thou art All-kind, Generous.
